gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-puritan: Nasalization floats its letters well apart, with short ascenders and a c opened like a pair of calipers. The heading catches the eye; Puritan's rounded, oversized counters carry the reading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-questrial: Nasalization spaces its letters wide, with short ascenders and a big lowercase that feels friendly and open. But Questrial brings flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight, the pair's crispest quality.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada stands its c, s and z tall and full. Nasalization's floating, short-ascender letters lead the page, while the body keeps a steady, pressure-free line with clear openings at each curve.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-radio-canada-: A c opened like a pair of calipers gives Nasalization its signature, along with short ascenders. And Radio Canada Big keeps paragraphs moving, its monoline strokes and line-filling x-height leaving terminals free of the stem.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads steadily, with broad gaps at every terminal. Nasalization lends the headings a friendly, spaced-out look, and the text below settles into a quiet, unvarying weight that holds up over pages.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-roboto: Spaced out and friendly: Nasalization draws curves that match its stems exactly, with short ascenders above a big lowercase. Nasalization makes the statement; Roboto handles the text with generous round mouths.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-ruda: Nasalization lets its big lowercase float, short ascenders and wide gaps giving every heading a friendly, unhurried feel. Ruda's wire-like monoline strokes and sizable x-height are the standout.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-saira: Friendly and spaced wide, Nasalization looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter, with short ascenders. Saira follows with rounded letters reaching high and an s you can see through.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch keeps a clearly open mouth on its lowercase e and a compact gap up to the ascender line. Nasalization, free of hairlines in any letter, makes the pair distinctive.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-schibsted-gro: Schibsted Grotesk reads approachably, with big, tall-bowled e and a shapes and terminals that never close in. Nasalization makes its diagonals count, while the body handles the words.
